turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi there! Sure. Small rule first: he / she / it + verb + s. Example: I work. He works.

Now you: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. Just write the verb.
